name: betaaur
label: Beta Aurigae (Menkalinan)
sources: [S07] Southworth, Bruntt & Buzasi 2007, A&A 467, 1215 (WIRE photometry): P, i, masses, radii, Teff
[vL07] van Leeuwen 2007, A&A 474, 653 (Hipparcos re-reduction): parallax 40.21 mas
[H95] Hummel et al. 1995, AJ 110, 376 (Mark III interferometric orbit)
Jonak et al. 2026 (arXiv:2609.03886): CHARA + RVs + closure phases resolve the node ambiguity (Omega = 295.15)
Bright Star Catalogue V = 1.90, B-V = 0.03 -> g ~ 1.80, i ~ 2.10 (Jester et al. 2005)
notes: semimajor_au from Kepler's third law with the [S07] masses (4.667 Msun) and period: a^3 = M P^2 -> 0.08186 AU = 3.29 mas at 24.87 pc (H95 measured 3.3 +/- 0.1 mas; Jonak et al. 2026: 3.365 mas at 24.30 pc).
node_pa_deg: Jonak et al. 2026, 295.15 deg (H95's 115.4 is the other node).

summary.sources: Southworth et al. 2007; Hipparcos; Jonak et al. 2026 (Ω)
